layouts.guidance: Demonstrate safe traversal along the top-edge corridor while avoiding central-fire placements. Show a consistent approach to move from a top-row start toward the goal column without stepping into central columns where fire is likely.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces fire-avoidance timing and corridor-following behavior within the top-edge corridor under randomized start/goal/fire placements.
layouts.rationale: This layout emphasizes maintaining the top-edge path while central column fires are present, forcing avoidance of central fire placements along the corridor.
